title: Exercise Every Day
subtitle: 考点：运动习惯 / Do some exercise every day.

dialogue.t: Ben, you look strong. What do you do every day?
I do some exercise every day. I run for half an hour after school.
I have less free time now. I play games on my phone for two hours.
Two hours is too long. You should play for less time.
Come and run with me. Exercise is good for your body.

vocab: exercise 锻炼 · free 空闲的 · phone 手机 · less 更少 · hour 小时 · habit 习惯 · show 显示
